About me
:

I capture authentic emotions and turn them into cinematic stories shaped by composition, color, motion and detail.

:

I’m Mohammed Aseem, a cinematic photographer and videographer from India with 2 years of professional experience at Studio Mynz.

I specialize in capturing authentic emotions and transforming them into visually engaging cinematic stories.

My experience includes wedding photography, pre-wedding shoots, cinematic videos, creative photography and professional video editing.

I focus on composition, storytelling, color, motion and detail to create visuals that feel memorable and cinematic.
